IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Klippert, Finn, Pearson, McCune, Hope, and Ross

Bill.BriefDescription: Implementing a biometric matching system program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to implementing a biometric matching systemprogram; and adding a new section to chapter 46.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: As funds are available, upon implementation of a biometric matchingsystem program to verify the identity of applicants for, and holdersof, drivers' licenses and identicards, the department of licensingshall make the biometric matching system program available to officialgovernmental enforcement agencies to assist in the investigation by theagencies of suspected criminal activity or for the purposes ofverifying identity when a law enforcement officer is authorized by lawto request identification from an individual.
